{{Top|leg}}
A '''mine-spire''' was a facility on the world of [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] built around a type of metal-rich [[smoker]] which was particularly rich in industrial metals. These metals were then mined for export and helped to establish the wealth and credit of the Muuns and the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. They were similar to [[vault-spire]]s.
